title: Black Bean Salsa Soup
steps:
Soften onion, celery,
carrot 6 min. Add
oregano + cumin

Beans, salsa, broth.
Simmer 10 min, then
blend half of it

Cheese quesadillas,
2 min a side. Cut into
strips for dipping
vo: Soup night, ready in twenty-five minutes.
Black bean salsa soup, with quesadilla dippers.
You need black beans, a jar of mild salsa, onion, celery, carrot, flour tortillas and cheddar.
Soften the onion, celery and carrot for six minutes, then stir in oregano and cumin.
Add the beans, salsa and broth, simmer ten minutes, then blend about half so it's thick but chunky.
Make cheese quesadillas, two minutes a side, and cut them into strips for dipping.
